current_reference.target_sheet: Approved target sheet is a goal, not a purchased sheet.

opportunities: At each ACT_RESOLUTION supported by played evidence, reconcile any earned XP credit under the governing ledger; story closure alone does not grant credit.
After the first post-Embrace adaptation story, offer a sheet and ledger review. A purchase is available only if valid ACT_RESOLUTION credit exists and current rules permit it.
Before the 2010 handoff, compare current sheet, approvals, ledger, and target sheet; spend only through explicit player choice, valid credit, and current rules.
prohibitions: No spending, dots, Disciplines, merits, flaws, or state changes without player choice and legal review.
No manipulated rolls or guaranteed advancement.
advancement.consolidation: At least two separate post-transformation sheet-and-ledger review windows are built into the route. They may find no spendable credit; awards and purchases require actual play, valid ACT_RESOLUTION credit, current system rules, and player choice.
advancement.purchase_credit_policy: Review windows are guaranteed by the prepared route; funded purchases are not. A story or act closure by itself grants no XP. Credit requires a valid ACT_RESOLUTION and governing ledger validation.

criteria: Current history, state and source ledger reconcile with no future event pre-recorded.
Every route-critical story that actually ran has a local closure and actual outcome; declined routes are recorded as alternate/incomplete, not silently treated as complete.
For a transformation route, ST-FIRST-NIGHTS, ST-GRIEF-AND-BOUNDARIES and ST-CAINITE-ENTRY each have evidence of local closure and at least one adaptation choice is demonstrated.

At least two post-transformation review windows for legal development are offered; each purchase requires valid ACT_RESOLUTION credit, current rules, and explicit player choice. No minimum spend is required.
Family and NPC relationships reflect only played evidence; unknowns remain labeled.
Optional plots are resolved, abandoned, quiet or carried by player choice; no all-world-plot requirement.

The sheet and XP ledger reconcile without automatic grants, manipulated rolls, or unapproved purchases. Claim a fully V5-legal sheet only after generation, eligibility, clan/Embrace, freebies, cost, and approval gates pass against current rules and system sources; otherwise completion is creation-review only and the sheet remains explicitly partial, not CHARACTER_READY.
The player chooses whether to enter the principal 2010 chronicle.
No single test is required for graduation; the finite outcome is COMPLETE, ALTERNATE or INCOMPLETE.
